quick._note: 30-minute loaded window — matches the methodology of Operational_Qualification_Report.md so re-runs are comparable. Temporarily lower to 120000 for smoke iterations only; do not certify on a shortened window.

memory-storage._note: memory-engine POST /store-workflow (idempotent upsert). The old target http://localhost:3000/api/memory does not exist — only /api/memory/search is routed in Next, so every execution 500/404'd.

memory-retrieval._note: memory-engine GET /search. The old target /api/memory/search is GET-only + auth-gated; the driver POSTed JSON to it, hence the 405s.

supervisor-status._note: hydi-core /status. The harness orchestrates services itself — no supervisor.js runs, so :9999 can never answer during qualification (HYDI_REQUIRE_SUPERVISOR=false).

_failuresNote: These entries select WHICH scenarios run when chaos is requested. They do NOT enable chaos. Injection is destructive and only happens when the harness is invoked with --chaos.

acceptanceCriteria._dataIntegrityNote: No data integrity threshold is configured because the harness does not snapshot or diff durable state. That criterion is always reported NOT TESTED rather than graded.
